author: WPB7
summary: The bounded alpha.1 delta audit (interval ae0be4b5..v0.1.0-alpha.1): release/version architecture, the 50-identity registry, platform and audio axes, compiled effects, the C API and its two reproduced alpha.1 build failures, and twelve CNA documentation contradictions. The site already covers the alpha.1 facts as history and the 009d40f5 state; most tag-era defects are fixed. Residue added: the unenforced sharp-runtime revision recorded for alpha.1 (releases page) and the surviving 137-versus-140 L7 wording (issue candidate).

concepts.text: The alpha.1 tag v0.1.0-alpha.1 resolves to commit 1bb2145d99ed572dd4eb15009c34e2e5f410fcf0, tagged 2026-08-20 19:06:23 +0200.

target.evidence: git cat-file -p v0.1.0-alpha.1 in the CNA repository; docs/releases.html (checked at 009d40f5)

concepts.text: The alpha.1 audit covered the owner interval ae0be4b5..v0.1.0-alpha.1; code, CMake, headers, generated registries and tests outrank CNA's Markdown, which serves only as a discovery aid.
The owner interval contained 1,445 commits (215 first-parent) and 6,303 changed paths; the manuscript-sensitive window from its previous pin 7a64362e had 1,101 commits and 3,129 paths.
concepts.note: Size of an alpha.1-era audit interval; the site's own delta figures are for alpha.1 to 009d40f5.

concepts.text: alpha.1 was the first tagged release: SemVer 0.1.0-alpha.1 with a configure-generated <CNA/Version.hpp> exposing CNA_VERSION_* macros and CNA::getVersionString().
At alpha.1 the renderer registry had 50 public identities over 46 implementation families, including four families new in that release.
concepts.note: Curated to 25 identities over 21 families at 009d40f5; the alpha.1 count appears only as history on the releases page.

concepts.text: An empty CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERERS keeps singular mode; a non-empty compatible set compiles several families with CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER as the required in-set default, runtime resolution follows explicit request, environment request, default and opt-in fallback, and a device latches the renderer it resolved.

target.evidence: cmake/RendererSelection.cmake and modules/core GraphicsRendererSelection at 009d40f5; site pages checked

concepts.text: At alpha.1 the platform axis had four implemented selectors (SDL3, SDL2, HEADLESS, POSIX-only TERMINAL) with SDL12, WIN32 and EMSCRIPTEN reserved.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 there are seven implementations (native X11, WAYLAND and WIN32 added); SDL12 and EMSCRIPTEN remain reserved.

concepts.text: At alpha.1 CNA_AUDIO_PLATFORM selected SDL3, SDL2 or NULL independently of the platform.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 a fourth implementation, native ALSA with CNA's own mixer, exists.

concepts.text: At alpha.1 the Effect bytecode constructor accepted bounded XNA/FNA D3D9 Effect Framework bytecode, with FNA3D the normal route and three explicit experimental opt-ins; it never compiled .fx/HLSL source or accepted DXBC/MGFX.

target.evidence: Effect.cpp and the *_COMPILED_EFFECTS options at 009d40f5; site pages checked

concepts.note: At 009d40f5 compiled effects reach 14 of 25 identities in 10 families through nine default-OFF options plus FNA3D; no runtime .fx/DXBC/MGFX.

concepts.text: At alpha.1 the optional C17 adapter cna_c_api had 59 public headers and ABI 0.7.0, versioned independently of the product version.
concepts.note: The ABI is 0.29.0 at 009d40f5; product and ABI versions remain independent.

concepts.text: At alpha.1 the platform module made 15 framework/extension modules when Net was enabled, with the C API as a separate optional adapter.
tokens: One public include root per module
concepts.note: The module set grew after alpha.1 (content-pipeline, design, diagnostics, inspector, video-ffmpeg and others); the site's module page is current.

concepts.text: Device renderer identity accessors became runtime answers rather than constexpr build answers, because a multi-renderer build selects its renderer when the device is created.
At alpha.1 the tree had 568 candidate C++ test sources, 8,263 lexical GoogleTest definitions and 21 workflow files; none of these is an executed total.
tokens: Six populations that must not be added together
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 the site's counts are 904 files and 12,610 definitions with 20 workflow files; the rule that these are not executed totals is unchanged.

concepts.text: The alpha.1 release recorded sharp-runtime 625476d5 as the revision it was developed and verified against, but CNA's build does not enforce it and accepts any checkout through CNA_SHARP_RUNTIME_ROOT.

target.evidence: git show 1bb2145d:CHANGELOG.md and CHANGELOG.md at 009d40f5 (Dependency pins); local sharp-runtime commit 625476d5 (2026-08-19)

concepts.note: Added to the releases page (wpb7-alpha1-sharp-runtime) with the unchanged third-party gitlinks.

concepts.text: The runtime glTF route keeps every mesh group in one Model with skins, cameras, variants and a structured import report; the conformance corpus has 148 assets, of which the EasyGL L7 campaign captures 140 and rejects 8 safely.

target.evidence: docs/gltf-conformance.md and docs/gltf-l7-corpus-report.json at 009d40f5; gltf-conformance page (checked)

concepts.text: The release procedure keeps tag, changelog, CMake and Doxygen version consistent and states that the product version and the C ABI version move independently.

At alpha.1 the C API adapter did not build: with Net enabled a static assertion failed (49 renderer rows against 50 identities), and with CNA_ENABLE_NET=OFF configure succeeded but compilation failed on absent GamerServices headers.

target.evidence: CMakeLists.txt at 009d40f5 (if(CNA_BUILD_C_API AND NOT CNA_ENABLE_NET) FATAL_ERROR 'CNA_BUILD_C_API=ON requires CNA_ENABLE_NET=ON'); modules/c-api/src/CnaCApiCoreExt.cpp 25-row table

concepts.note: Positive evidence at 009d40f5: the incompatible tuple is refused at configure time (root CMakeLists.txt FATAL_ERROR) and the renderer table matches the 25 identities; docs/building.html and docs/c-api.html#blocker state both, and the site notes the library build itself was not re-verified (Known Issues items CNA-BUG-059/060).

concepts.text: Across the owner interval 823 header paths were added under modules/*/include (507 outside Internal/Detail); the previous-pin window had 344 changed include paths, 183 of them consumer-facing.
concepts.note: Path-level inventory of an alpha.1-era interval; path status is not an API classification.

concepts.text: CNA/Entrypoint.hpp and CNA/Platform.hpp were removed and replaced by the platform module's CNA/Platform/Entrypoint.hpp and platform contract, so SDL implementation types left the framework's public surface.

The high-risk alpha.1 signature changes were the device renderer accessors losing constexpr, the explicit platform-owning Game seam, the moved entry-point include and the compiled Effect constructor becoming operational.

An exact-tag configure (HEADLESS graphics and platform, NULL audio, tests/examples/Net/C API off, GNU 14.2) printed 'CNA: version 0.1.0-alpha.1', derived the then-current family count, and a C++23 program including <CNA/Version.hpp> printed 0.1.0-alpha.1.
concepts.note: Build evidence for the alpha.1 tag only; not re-run for 009d40f5.

concepts.text: Two alpha.1 C API builds failed reproducibly: Net off stopped at the GameUpdateRequiredException.hpp include; Net on stopped at the adapter's deliberate (49 == 50) static assertion because one identity had no C constant.
concepts.note: Compile-proven failures at the tag; fixed at 009d40f5 (see WPB7-a1d-017).

concepts.section: CNA documentation contradictions at the tag
concepts.text: At the tag CHANGELOG.md said 49 renderer identities and docs/runtime-renderer-selection.md said 45 factories, while the registries had 50 identities and 46 families.
concepts.note: Alpha.1 document drift. At 009d40f5 docs/runtime-renderer-selection.md states 21 families / 25 identities and is counted by check_renderer_identities.py; the surviving CHANGELOG line is Known Issues item CNA-BUG-055.

concepts.section: CNA documentation contradictions at the tag
concepts.text: At the tag the compiled-effect documentation table omitted Vulkan's explicit opt-in route although CMake and the implementation had it.

target.evidence: docs/fx-compiled-effects.md at 009d40f5 (VULKAN row, CNA_VULKAN_COMPILED_EFFECTS off by default; 'Vulkan joined the supported set on 2026-08-18')

concepts.note: Positive evidence: the table at 009d40f5 lists VULKAN with its option alongside SDL_GPU, the EasyGL family, DIRECTX11 and DIRECTX12.

concepts.section: CNA documentation contradictions at the tag
concepts.text: At the tag XnbBuiltInReaders kept a comment saying the EffectReader always throws, after it had become a bounded compiled-effect route.
concepts.note: Positive evidence: the file registers the Effect reader through RegisterEffectXnbReader and carries no such comment at 009d40f5.

concepts.section: CNA documentation contradictions at the tag
concepts.text: At the tag the C API limitations prose said 6,415 canonical declarations against a 6,712-row generated inventory, and the release-gate label still named ABI 0.1.0 against abi.h's 0.7.0.
concepts.note: Alpha.1 figures. The ABI-label mismatch is fixed (CNA-BUG-056); the limitations prose still disagrees with its inventory at 009d40f5 in a different form (CNA-BUG-058, WP21-i003), handled by Known Issues.

concepts.section: CNA documentation contradictions at the tag
concepts.text: At the tag the general and two Input workflow legs selected EASYGL, a family name rather than an accepted identity, so those configurations failed before compiling.

target.evidence: .github/workflows at 009d40f5: no workflow selects EASYGL (20 files searched)

concepts.note: Positive evidence: no workflow file at 009d40f5 passes EASYGL as a renderer (Known Issues CNA-BUG-030, fixed).

concepts.section: CNA documentation contradictions at the tag
concepts.text: The changelog's narrow 'no general .xnb pipeline route' wording must not be read as 'CNA cannot load XNB': the runtime has a real XNB container, object graph and registered reader set.

concepts.section: CNA documentation contradictions at the tag
concepts.text: The release summary's XNA-surface and media-shell counts were methodology-limited snapshots, not generated tag invariants.
tokens: Counts are snapshots of a method

concepts.section: CNA documentation contradictions at the tag
concepts.text: The EasyGL L7 report's justification text said 137 renderable assets while its machine fields and disposition array recorded 140 captures plus eight rejections.

target.evidence: docs/gltf-l7-corpus-report.json and tests/gltf-l7/easygl-policy.json at 009d40f5 (justification vs capturedAssetCount 140 / rejectedAssetCount 8)

concepts.note: Still present at 009d40f5; used as the illustration of hand-written numbers lagging generated fields (issue WPB7-i004).

concepts.section: CNA documentation contradictions at the tag
concepts.text: At the tag docs/c-api/RELEASE_GATE.md reported the experimental ABI 'Ready' because its checker recognised gate definitions without building the final library or an installed consumer.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 the gate reads Not ready (468 unmapped public symbols) and the site states that no CI job builds the C library.

concepts.section: CNA documentation contradictions at the tag
concepts.text: At the tag CMake accepted CNA_BUILD_C_API=ON with CNA_ENABLE_NET=OFF and failed later during compilation instead of refusing the tuple at configure time.
concepts.note: Positive evidence: the root CMakeLists.txt refuses the combination at configure time at 009d40f5; docs/building.html states it (CNA-BUG-060, fixed).

concepts.text: At audit time the ordinary CNA checkout equalled the tag and git log/diff tag..HEAD were empty, so no post-tag work had to be excluded; the detached tag worktree was used regardless.
concepts.note: Audit hygiene for the alpha.1 edition: a record of how the book was made, with no CNA behaviour to document.
